plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: Four gaps. (1) C3: no instrument checks the category against the requester's rule. Summary of the change only counts values the agreement fixes, and the agreement fixes none for the category. (2) C5: scope of a call can only be asked on named read lines, paid from the allowance, so it cannot go in the plan. Covering all 100 account reads would cost far more than the allowance of 50. (3) C10: no plan instrument checks the outbox. Trace of a call works only on named lines at A3, costs 10 per line, and the allowance pays for at most 5 lines. I will spend it on sending calls that were ordered and not confirmed, or that look odd. (4) No instrument reads the live tables directly. After the promotion, same set and summary of the change only repeat what they said about the staged set. I left out undo rehearsal at A3 and the extra same set and summary answers at A2 and A3, because they would add nothing that settles a clause.
